Body.Content:
Azure Automation in the Preview portal has added the ability for you to view runbooks in read-only mode. From a runbook blade, you can view the published version of the runbook, and from a job blade, you can view the version of the runbook that was used to run the job.  This enables you to quickly get information about a runbook.
View Runbook Published Version
View Job Runbook Source
